philosophy: S16–S18 are agent-value rows. required_jobs is independent of B2. B1 is expected to over-run. S01–S14 stay in scenarios.json.

scenarios.title: Unknown script imports score
scenarios.description: An unclassified helper imports ranker.score. B1 cannot name that edge.
scenarios.rationale: Same impact class as S03 (score code). ingest/prepare are not required. Path is unknown to B1, so B1 runs the full graph. A verifier-accepted import edge can localize to score_code.

scenarios.title: Hidden overlay path
scenarios.description: Unmapped ops/prod_weights.json extends scoring_weights.json and carries genre weights.
scenarios.rationale: Same impact class as S12 (scoring overlay). The filename is not scoring_weights.json, so B1 classifies unknown and over-runs. The file contains the overlay needle and weight payload. ingest/prepare/test are not required.

scenarios.title: Docs plus unknown score import
scenarios.description: Documentation plus the S16 helper. Unknown residue dominates B1.
scenarios.rationale: Docs alone would be S01 (branch_guard). The unknown import has S03 impact. B1 unions conservatively to the full graph. Localizing only the script yields the S03 job set.
